{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
data_clean = data[~qa_mask]

# Remove refunded orders
refunded_mask = data_clean['status'] == 'refunded'
data_final = data_clean[~refunded_mask]

# Calculate total revenue by channel
total_revenue_by_channel = data_final.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum().reset_index()
print("Total revenue by channel:")
print(total_revenue_by_channel)

# Find the channel with the most revenue
max_revenue_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.loc[total_revenue_by_channel['revenue_clean'].idxmax()]['channel']
print(f"\nChannel with the most revenue: {max_revenue_channel}")"}
